finding.description: The lesson explicitly says to add -s after he/she while presenting "studies" as an example, concealing the required consonant-plus-y spelling change and giving an incomplete account of third-person-singular subjects.
finding.recommendation: Replace the rule with a bounded accurate formulation such as: "With he, she, it, or one person or thing, use the third-person form. Usually add -s (live → lives); after a consonant + y, change y to -ies (study → studies)."

finding.description: The title "Foundational exchange: foundations" is repetitive, and "another beat" is an imprecise description of the unwanted vowel after final /z/.
finding.recommendation: Use a specific title such as "Talking about facts and routines" and say "Do not add an extra vowel sound after /v/ or /z/."
